The [background page](../../background.qmd) presents the original study and the two studies of SCORE that took it up, the robustness study with its five reanalyses [@AczelEtAl2026InvestigatingAnalyticalRobustness] and the replicability study with its new experiment. The part-day format takes Tasks 1 to 4, and you do them in the slides of the session, which run R inside your browser with the data already in place. The [browser lab](../../lab.qmd) holds the same tasks and is the fallback if the slides do not load.

## The tasks

The session takes four of the six numbered tasks of the exercise, in the cells of its slides.

### Task 1 – The setup check

Wait for the engine of the slides to finish downloading, then run the setup cell.

### Task 2 – The estimand statement

Write the **estimand statement** behind the claim in your notes. It says which comparison is made (Hispanic names against which names), which emails are counted (the replies, or every delivered email), and which outcome is compared. The [specification menu](../../menu.qmd) gives the template.

### Task 3 – The reproduction

Reproduce the analysis of one of the five analysts in the table above from the public file of the OAs, `housing_original.csv` ([codebook](../../data/housing_original_codebook.md)), in the cells of that analyst. Then find out why your number is what it is. A reproduction depends on the defaults and the codings of the software as well as on the data and the model.

### Task 4 – The menu

This task is **exploratory**: nothing in it is preregistered, and you may look, change your mind and try again. Try several specifications from the [specification menu](../../menu.qmd) with `try_spec()`, one decision at a time, and note which choices move the estimate and which barely touch it. Then choose the one that you would defend and run it once more, so that it is your last try, because the slides place it among the `r nrow(curve)` specifications of the curve. The session sends nothing to the class chart.

### Task 5 – Preregistration

The session stops before this task, in which you choose **one** specification and complete a preregistration block before you run it, and before the class chart. The page [Outside the workshop](after.qmd) says where to take both up.
